proposed_capability: MoonWake /the-closers: use operator-provided paused Sims 4 screenshot showing a hover-highlighted actual SUPER FERTILIZER object (tooltip: 'Super Fertilizer', description mentioning Jasmine and Growfruit Challenge, displayed §80) to replace misleading generic FERTILIZER_BAG-only identity assumptions with structured, capture-bound hover-identity recognition and safe in-inventory transfer scheduling; repair actual post-merge PR239 review findings for stock priority, pending and partial-stock flow.
player_save_control_impact: Sanitized operator-provided tooltip metadata enters a read-only classifier; no raw screenshot or player identity in public Git, no OS/game input, cursor, screen hooks, personal-save reads or mutation, EA asset redistribution, invented game object ID, new money cost or player queue override. Existing source-only transfer port remains advisory.
expected_outcome: Exact screenshot tooltip SUPER FERTILIZER and its pointed/highlighted ground object are recognized as a candidate independent of generic bag silhouette, with displayed §80 not treated as a purchase price. An optional current-host verified hover can bind to actual bag identity only if current actor/lot/capture, ownership, source eligibility, observed transfer affordance and output pocket proof are independently provided. Fix all PR239 post-merge review: full stock bypass stale scan, pending pickup cannot block sufficient pocket fertilizer, partial pocket allows one verified FERTILIZE even when no transfer available; demonstrate genuinely distinct later observation in regression.
negative_tests: A decorative object, missing or misleading hover title, label-only OCR, disconnected tooltip pointer, wrong target, screenshot as autonomous game permit fail closed
Displayed §80 value must not create an unreviewed purchase action or alter funds
Only current host/verified actor+lot+capture and observed target affordance can create one advisory transfer
Unknown fertilizer eligibility and source-only screenshot require reobservation, never an action
Existing legacy bags and optional spatial map continue working
Malformed/stale optional backyard scan and pending transfer must not block already sufficient pocket inventory
Insufficient pocket plus inaccessible bags still fertilizes a single eligible plant if observed
Independent post-transfer capture should differ from the prior proposal and should not infer completion without plant proof
rollback_path: Revert independent isolated PR to #239 merged source; no game/host mutation
